title: Catching a shoplifter in time
target: How to react to a shoplifter in Supermarket Simulator using the warning the game already gives you, instead of finding out about the loss after the goods have left the building.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with customers coming through the door
Someone free to watch the shop rather than just the till

steps.do: Watch the warning indicator and not only the checkout queue.
steps.because: the game keeps a shoplifter indicator of its own (ShoplifterIndicator)

steps.do: Act on the warning rather than waiting for the door to tell you.
steps.because: the warning is raised with a delay rather than the moment the theft starts (NetworkShoplifterIndicator)

steps.do: Keep the door detector working instead of treating it as decoration.
steps.because: the game ships a detector built for the shop door (T_ThiefDetector_AlbedoTransparency)

steps.do: Learn the behaviour in the tutorial rather than meeting it for the first time in a busy shop.
steps.because: the game introduces it through a tutorial shoplifter (TutorialShoplifter)

steps.do: Decide how much of it you want before your shop grows.
steps.because: shoplifter frequency is a setting that can be enabled or left off (ShoplifterSpawnSettingSO)

commonMistakes: Waiting for the door to sound before doing anything.
Treating every customer as a thief.
Turning the behaviour on and then never watching the shop floor.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
